description: Does nothing while DispatchEnabled is No, or for posts first published before UrgentGoLiveDate. Triggers when an urgent news post on HPUK News is published (a major version, Show in News not No, Status not Expired, Urgent Yes, UrgentSent No). Only posts authored or last edited by an authorised urgent publisher (UrgentPublisherEmails) are sent; others are logged and Communications is told. Audience-targeted posts are never broadcast to whole ports: Communications is told instead. Otherwise it sends the notice once per matching Comms Distribution port and channel (company-wide All ports rows are roundup-only and never get urgent alerts) (email from the Communications mailbox, Teams channel post), keyed by site, page, NotificationRound, port#Comms Distribution row ID and channel in the Delivery Log (a Failed row is claimed for a retry with an ETag check; each row is read again just before sending, and one switched off during the run is skipped and reported), and reserves each key before sending, so edits and re-runs never resend; an unknown outcome is logged as Reconcile for a person to check. UrgentSent is set only when every delivery succeeds, without creating a new page version. To send again, Communications sets UrgentSent back to No and raises NotificationRound by one.

conditions.expression: @and(equals(triggerBody()?['PromotedState'], 2), equals(triggerBody()?['Urgent'], true), not(equals(triggerBody()?['UrgentSent'], true)), not(equals(triggerBody()?['ShowinNews'], false)), not(equals(triggerBody()?['Status']?['Value'], 'Expired')), endsWith(string(triggerBody()?['{VersionNumber}']), '.0'))

parameters.$filter: @{concat('Title eq ''', outputs('Dispatch_prefix'), '|Skipped - not an urgent publisher''')}

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: Urgent notice not sent: publisher not authorised
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
@{triggerBody()?['Title']} (HPUK News)

This post is marked Urgent, but neither its author (@{triggerBody()?['Author']?['Email']}) nor its last editor (@{triggerBody()?['Editor']?['Email']}) is an authorised urgent publisher, so nothing was sent. If it should go out, an urgent publisher can republish it.

@{triggerBody()?['Title']} (HPUK News)

This urgent notice is targeted to an audience, so it was not sent to whole ports. Send it to the intended group directly, or remove the audience and set NotificationRound up by one to broadcast it.

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: Urgent notice not sent: no enabled destination
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
@{triggerBody()?['Title']} (HPUK News)

No enabled Comms Distribution row matches this notice's Port. Check the Port value on the post and the Enabled rows in Comms Distribution.

Get_destination_now.description: Reads the Comms Distribution row again just before sending, so switching a row's Enabled to No stops it even in a run already going, and the current address is used.

Email_Reserve_retry.description: Claims the Failed row only if nobody has changed it since it was read (If-Match on its ETag). Another run that claimed it first makes this fail with 412, and nothing is sent.

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: Urgent notice sent, but UrgentSent could not be set
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
@{triggerBody()?['Title']} (HPUK News)

Every delivery is logged as Sent, but setting UrgentSent to Yes failed or didn't read back. Set UrgentSent to Yes on the page by hand. Nothing will be resent: every destination is already reserved as Sent in the Delivery Log.

@{triggerBody()?['Title']} (HPUK News)

These deliveries did not complete:

@{join(variables('Failures'), '
')}

Not yet logged as Sent: @{if(equals(actions('Filter_not_yet_sent')?['status'], 'Succeeded'), join(coalesce(actions('Filter_not_yet_sent')?['outputs']?['body'], json('[]')), '
'), 'the Delivery Log could not be read, so completion is unknown')}

UrgentSent has been left at No.

A row logged as Reconcile may or may not have arrived: check with the recipient. If it didn't arrive, set the row's Delivery status to Failed and resubmit this run. Only Failed rows are ever retried. A row still Reserved was sent but not logged: set it to Sent.

Catch_run_failed.description: Run-level failure alert: any error in Scope_Main that no step handled.

parameters.emailMessage/Body:
The flow @{workflow()?['tags']?['flowDisplayName']} stopped with an error it did not handle, so some of its work may not have been done. Nothing has been retried.

Run: @{workflow()?['run']?['name']} (started @{workflow()?['run']?['startTime']})

    @{join(body('Select_failed_steps'), '')}

Open the run, find the failed step and its raw output, fix the cause, then resubmit the run or deal with the items by hand. Check for partial changes first (see Stopping and recovery in the deployment guide).
